acceptance.failure: stop large matrix; diagnose; do not widen
acceptance.paired_effect: same sign and |new-parent dlogPPL| <= max(0.25*abs(parent dlogPPL),0.002)

calibration.draw_rule: parent campaign/data.keyed_draw deterministic SHA-256 keyed ordering; documents/crops are mutually exclusive across seed0 and draw1-draw4 and excluded from evaluation

larger_nested_draws.128+128: the exact seed0 64+64 prefix plus deterministic key size128_v1, excluding seed0 and draw1-draw4, until 128 per domain
larger_nested_draws.256+256: the exact 128+128 prefix plus deterministic key size256_v1, excluding every preceding calibration sample, until 256 per domain

calibration.stored_statistics: float64 per-sequence sums, sums of squares and cross-products sufficient to recompute means, sample variances and SE; raw retained where feasible

carryover_bundle_repairs.finite_monte_carlo_plus_one: fixed and tested in extension source
carryover_bundle_repairs.independent_accuracy_rng: fixed and tested in extension source
required_in_new_bundle: replace Windows-unsafe angle-bracket lock filenames with safe logical names
state that evaluation CIs are conditional on the stored map and separately report draw variability

hierarchy: robust post-hoc k2 quality extension without new mechanism
N16/N8 engineering trade-off study without measured deployment benefit
map-level robustness plus tile-level negative result
claim_classification.selection_rule: choose the narrowest classification supported by all gates; never omit contrary evidence

claim_label_required: k=2 was selected after the completed parent sweep and is post-hoc; only the prospectively reserved held-out validation after winner freeze may be called held-out

detached_hash_rule.overwrite: forbidden; any scientifically necessary change is a hash-chained amendment and cannot retroactively change an opened endpoint
detached_hash_rule.rule: SHA-256 is over the exact bytes of freeze/PROTOCOL_EXTENSION.json; the digest is detached to avoid a self-referential field

density_controls.eligibility_and_ties: exact same module/weight eligibility mask; finite scores before nonfinite; score then module name,row,K; no repeated random draw
density_controls.n8_matching: one N16K64 tile equals 1024 weights and one N8K64 tile equals 512; select exactly twice the N8 tile count where divisible
density_controls.rounding: floor each stratum then allocate remaining tiles by largest fractional remainder; ties by module name then row then K index; report residual
density_controls.target: exact selected-weight count of N16 k2, both globally and separately per layer/module

draw_aggregation.eligibility: median six-cell dlogPPL versus seed0 <= -0.0005 and worst cell <= +0.001
draw_aggregation.pooled_rule: pool per-sequence sufficient statistics then recompute mean/sample variance/SE; never average masks
selection: if tied, highest median leave-one-draw-out map Jaccard

format_preserving_quantizer.activation_rule: causal per-token row only; MSE grid chooses among [0.90,0.95,1.00] times row absmax using that row; percentiles use only the current row; four-bit FourOverSix values retained
format_preserving_quantizer.combination: combine only independently passing best weight and activation choices with the frozen selector; evaluate baseline plus single-axis screens before the combination
format_preserving_quantizer.independent_pass: median six-cell dlogPPL versus existing scale <= -0.0005 and worst cell <= +0.001
format_preserving_quantizer.local_transform: P62 stopped_by_gate unless a pre-result algebraic/folding/MMA-scope proof shows no hidden high-precision state and accounts for every metadata bit and operation
format_preserving_quantizer.weight_rule: multiply the existing per-scale-block absmax-derived dequantization scale; identical E2M1/E0M3 codes, scope and scale-block count

k.eligibility: all six cells dlogPPL(candidate minus N16 k2 seed0) <= +0.001
lexicographic_selection: smallest median dlogPPL versus N16 k2
if still tied, fewer total selected weights

selector_candidates.activation_weighted_error: per-tile L1 E0M3-minus-E2M1 weight error weighted by calibration input-channel RMS, averaged across development calibration only
selector_candidates.combined: not primary; may be attempted only after component results, with frozen coefficients fit on development tile interventions and no evaluation-window outcomes
selector_candidates.diagonal_hessian_gptq_proxy: per-tile squared quantization-error change weighted by the diagonal empirical input Gram/Hessian proxy E[x_j^2] with damping 0.01*mean(diagonal)
selector_candidates.layer_output_reconstruction: per-tile change in mean squared linear-layer output reconstruction error on cached development calibration inputs
selector_candidates.staging: derive/store scores first; evaluate one map per named candidate plus old selector and strongest deterministic heuristic, not a Cartesian product with scale/clipping

tile_fidelity.sampling: deterministic weighted allocation without replacement; redistribute empty-stratum quota lexicographically and store inclusion probabilities

accuracy.harness: lm-eval 0.4.11 HFLM with parent offline documents and seeds (0,1234,1234,1234)
accuracy.macro: unweighted mean of the eight task-level accuracy differences; MMLU is one task after pooling its frozen 57 subjects

gsm8k.retain: all prompts, generations, extracted answers and paired item outcomes

pg19.inference: resample source books; fewer than 20 valid books is exploratory point-estimate-only
pg19.selection: for each tokenizer take the first 20 books in frozen file order with at least 8193 tokens; use nested prefix windows at both lengths; do not replace based on quality

portability.map: generate/freeze on clean A6000 and evaluate the byte-identical map on both devices; no Ada regeneration substitution
portability.paired_effect_tolerance: same sign and absolute A6000-vs-Ada dlogPPL difference <= max(0.25*abs(A6000 effect),0.002)
portability.windows: first 16 frozen WikiText windows and first 16 frozen C4 windows

ppl.aggregation: raw PPL=exp(total token NLL/total predicted tokens); store per-window token count, NLL sum, source cluster and pairing key
ppl.c4: parent-pinned allenai/c4 en validation shard revision 1588ec454efa1a09f29cd18ddd04fe05fc8653a2; exact parent Random(0) 256-document 2048-token crops
ppl.wikitext: parent-pinned Salesforce/wikitext wikitext-2-raw-v1 test revision b08601e04326c79dfdd32d625aee71d232d685c3; all full non-overlapping windows of joined text

gates_and_thresholds.G0_integrity: input hashes, exact authoritative attempt resolution, model/map/evaluator identities, GPU preflight, and both exact-map anchors must pass; no tolerance widening
gates_and_thresholds.G1_k2_breadth: Holm over six N16 k2-vs-FourOverSix endpoints; beneficial point estimates on both corpora for at least two of three breadth models; no cell >= practical material-regression threshold; report aggregate with and without Qwen
gates_and_thresholds.G2_k2_vs_k3: Holm over six breadth endpoints and frozen aggregate; no family-level material regression; differences smaller than the practical threshold are scientifically equivalent even if statistically detectable
gates_and_thresholds.G3_density_selector: at equal selected-weight budget N16 candidate must beat median random and show consistent advantage over deterministic controls; otherwise classify natural gain as density-driven
gates_and_thresholds.G4_n16_vs_n8: report natural and selected-weight-matched contrasts; worse N16 quality can only support an unmeasured engineering trade-off, never a favorable overhead claim

G5_calibration_256_continuation.continue_if: at least 2 of 3 model averages <= -0.0005 and every individual model/corpus cell <= +0.001
G5_calibration_256_continuation.estimand: for N16 k2, per development model average of WikiText and C4 dlogPPL(128+128 minus 64+64)
G5_calibration_256_continuation.otherwise: all P32 cells stopped_by_gate; report P31 fully

G6_selector_replacement.claim: causal selector replacement requires all full-map, sign and rank conditions; PPL-only success is empirical selection quality only
G6_selector_replacement.full_map: at equal budget, median across six development cells dlogPPL(candidate minus old selector) <= -0.0005 and worst cell <= +0.001
G6_selector_replacement.tile_rank: cluster/stratum bootstrap 95% lower bound for Spearman rho > 0; also report Kendall tau
G6_selector_replacement.tile_sign: exact-binomial 95% lower confidence bound > 0.5 and sign-accuracy point gain over old selector >= 0.15

gates_and_thresholds.G7_quantizer: candidate must retain exact four-bit E2M1/E0M3 value formats and W4A4 scope and fully disclose scale metadata/high-precision exceptions/unfused operations; hidden high-precision work, noncausal calibration, or incompatible MMA scope is rejected or separately labeled
gates_and_thresholds.G8_heldout_downstream: global winner hash-frozen before held-out quality; evaluate both reserved families; positive general-quality claim also requires frozen accuracy non-inferiority after correction
gates_and_thresholds.G9_sota: only if one frozen method beats the strongest fair baseline on a broad non-cherry-picked panel with corrected inference; any missing baseline cells or material RaZeR wins prohibit broad SOTA wording
gates_and_thresholds.practical_ppl_definition: log(1.005); a >=0.5% relative PPL regression is material

gpu_policy.foreign_process_action: stop only this campaign run, preserve evidence, mark invalid_cotenancy, safely release and requeue; never signal another user's process

parent_campaign.preservation: read-only mount; all negative, OOM, failed, superseded, and invalid/co-tenancy attempts remain in the parent and are included in final disclosure

primary_k2_rule.n16_construction: sum the two adjacent N8-row per-sequence CE and KL scores first, then recompute mean, sample SD, SE, and the election; never OR/AND N8 masks

quality_results_opened_before_lock.known_parent_development_and_posthoc_res: the parent reports and handoff EXISTING_*.csv tables were already viewed; they remain development/post-hoc and cannot become prospective

quantization_semantics.activation: same causal per-token FourOverSix row quantizer unless a separately labeled activation-ablation arm is used
identity_match_required: model repository/revision and all weight/config/tokenizer hashes
module scope, exclusions, padding and tile layout
attention backend, dtype, batch, cache and runtime
exact map hash and pre-map model checksum
quantization_semantics.scope: all text-model torch.nn.Linear weights except lm_head; embeddings, norms, KV cache and lm_head excluded
quantization_semantics.weights: same scale and module scope except selected E2M1/E0M3 tile format

research_roles.heldout_no_swap_rule: Neither model, revision, tokenizer, family, or quantized scope may be replaced after any held-out quality result is opened. Unsupported or OOM outcomes remain terminal evidence rather than permission to swap.
research_roles.qwen_family_reporting: qwen4b is a known large-effect development outlier; always report non-Qwen aggregates and never treat Qwen models as exchangeable independent families

scope.allowed: software BF16-dequantized fake-quant quality experiments for W4A4 methods on A6000 and RTX 6000 Ada
scope.forbidden_claim_rule: no fake-quant timing or A6000/Ada result may be presented as native execution or deployment overhead evidence
out_of_scope: native FP4 or E0M3 Tensor Core execution

analysis_fixes.accuracy_rng: stable named NumPy SeedSequence task streams; Python hash() forbidden

source_state_at_lock.per_run_identity: every attempt records its own immutable source manifest; later implementation work cannot alter this lock or prior run manifests

accuracy.noninferiority: paired macro lower 95% CI > -0.5 percentage points after frozen correction

bootstrap.rng: numpy PCG64 via stable named SeedSequence streams

statistics.draws: report every draw, mean, median, range, worst, between-draw sample SD, t_4 interval, beneficial fraction, pairwise map Jaccard and count variability; within-evaluation and between-draw uncertainty remain separate

families.accuracy: eight task-level paired winner-vs-FourOverSix endpoints for each tested model; model panels reported separately
families.breadth_quality: six N16 k2-vs-FourOverSix endpoints on qwen27b, phi4, olmo2_13b
families.heldout_quality: four winner-vs-FourOverSix endpoints on granite8b and falcon3_10b
families.strongest_baseline: opened only after preceding gates, baseline selected without N16/winner outcome peeking
families.threshold_improvement: six N16 k2-vs-N16 k3 endpoints on the same panel
families.tile_shape: six selected-weight-matched N16-vs-N8 endpoints on the same panel

statistics.post_selection: no naive development winner confidence interval is labeled confirmatory; confirmatory inference starts only after winner hash freeze on unopened held-out endpoints
statistics.tile_fidelity: exact binomial sign CI; Spearman and Kendall with stratified bootstrap; predicted-vs-observed calibration; sampling weights

winner_freeze.contents: exact source manifest, maps/hashes, model-independent configuration, scale/clip/selector/aggregation/k, module scope, calibration manifests, evaluation plan, comparators and analysis hash
winner_freeze.fallback: N16 k2 seed0 with existing scale and activation if no development candidate passes its frozen gate
